world.name: Black Woods
world.blurb: Black Woods: one continuous road with 11 checkpointed challenges, ending in a superroom.
world.outro: Black Woods, refuge to root door, with the blade in hand.

keepsake.name: Elsie’s Lantern
keepsake.gives: Elsie hangs it over her table and sets out a second bowl. In the Fractured Woods it opens Elsie’s echo.

rooms.name: Mothlight Refuge
rooms.hint: Jump up through a plank from below · a cracked board gives way
rooms.question: The refuge is built up the trunk. Which boards carry you to the high walk?

people.line: Stopped again. Don’t ask me the time.
Not resin crew, are you? A cut pod kicks. Get a blade.
You again. The tunnel comes up right here. Refuge is ahead.

rooms.name: Oathblade Clearing
rooms.hint: Strike with the blade · a cut lights a stake the hand can’t reach
rooms.question: The stake is caged in roots. What reaches farther than your hand?

people.line: Sword was in those roots. Cost me a shoulder. Take it.

rooms.name: Mothlight Descent
rooms.hint: Strike a moth pod and it throws you away from the cut · a struck pod gives your dash back
rooms.question: The thorns are wider than a dash. What in the air can you push off?

rooms.name: Briar Run
rooms.hint: Each pod you cut is one more dash
rooms.question: Three pods climb toward the bank. How much higher does each one carry you?

rooms.name: Elsie’s Kitchen
rooms.hint: A cut lights a stake in passing · the gate opens when it is lit
rooms.question: The gate wants the stake lit, and the stake hangs over the thorns. What gets you up to it?

people.line: Mind the step. Elsie. My lantern’s stuck up in the branches. Fetch it?

rooms.name: Thicket’s Edge
rooms.hint: Every dash swaps the true branches and the copies
rooms.question: The copies turn true when you dash. Where will the next dash put a floor?

people.line: Easy, easy… Bram. Light goes through a branch? It isn’t there.

rooms.name: Mirror Thicket
rooms.hint: A struck bell swaps the thicket too, and costs no dash
rooms.question: The far branch is true now. How do you keep it true after the dash that gets you there?

rooms.name: Rootbound Passage
rooms.hint: One cut can catch a pod and a bell together
rooms.question: Two dashes to cross, and the far floor wants an odd number of swaps. Where does the extra one come from?

rooms.name: The Lantern Tree
rooms.hint: The peg at the fork holds the line · cut it and the way up opens
rooms.question: The way up is tied shut from the fork. How do you climb a trunk that bites?

rooms.name: Miss One Ferry
rooms.hint: A missed ferry comes back. The stone pier is safe; the space between the boats is not.
rooms.question: Which connection should you let leave without you?

rooms.name: The Return Window
rooms.hint: The pale bridge disappears behind you. The recessed pockets lie outside the moving thorns’ paths.
rooms.question: The crossing out and the crossing back look similar. Which way will the next pass be moving?

rooms.name: Ask the Tree Twice
rooms.hint: Dash through the trunk. One downward cut can ring the bell and borrow the seed’s height. On the way home, keep the trunk real.
rooms.question: Which branch needs to disappear beneath you so the tree can become your way back?

rooms.name: The Canopy Vent
rooms.hint: Climb the branches toward the light in the hollow tree.

rooms.name: The Buried Spillway
rooms.hint: The inspection walk rises above the culvert shutter.

saved.name: Biting Canopy
saved.why: rated 7 — too hard for the second world; a later world gets it

saved.name: The Lantern Bough
saved.why: rated 9 (Elsie’s errand ends at The Lantern Tree for now)

retiredRoomDetails.name: The Root Tunnel
retiredRoomDetails.evidence: No active entity or switch: a thorn gap and climbable high bank, using only travel/jump/grab inputs. Wall climbing was taught by White Flowers in W1. Keep the arrival/rest function if replacing it.

retiredRoomDetails.name: The Called Name
retiredRoomDetails.evidence: Two bells and twenty cyan phase tiles extend the same dash/strike parity lesson as Mirror Thicket; Rootbound Passage immediately adds the more consequential pod-plus-bell combined cut. A new phase puzzle can occupy this middle repetition without removing the first bell lesson.

quest.doneLine: Two bowls and a working lamp. That’s supper. Sit before it gets cold.
lines: The moths took my lantern, off into the trees past the kitchen. They never go far at a time. Could you follow them?
Bring her home steady. If you fall, the moths will have her back.
